1. An overview of data protection

@@ -14,4 +15,31 @@ import LegalLayout from '../../layouts/LegalLayout.astro';

3. Recording of data on our website

Cookies

In some instances, our website and its pages use so-called cookies. Cookies do not cause any damage to your computer and do not contain viruses. The purpose of cookies is to make our website more user friendly, effective and more secure. Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer and stored by your browser.

+ +

4. Accounts: what we collect at sign-up and sign-in

+

To create an account we ask for only two things: a username and a password. We do not ask for your email address, real name, phone number, date of birth or location, and your username does not need to identify you.

+
    +
  • Purpose: your username and password are used only to create your account and sign you in. They are not used for advertising, profiling or analytics.
    • +
  • Where it goes: the form sends them over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection to our authentication service. No cookies or device identifiers are sent with them.
    • +
  • Third parties: analytics and advertising scripts are not loaded on the sign-in and sign-up pages, so they cannot observe what you type there.
    • +
  • Autofill: the forms are labelled so your browser or password manager can save and fill your credentials. We do not store them in your browser ourselves.
    • +
+ +

5. Third-party services on this website

+
    +
  • Analytics: on article and section pages, a small analytics script records the type and visible text of links and buttons you click, plus a timestamp. It does not receive the address of the page you are reading, and it is never loaded on account pages.
    • +
  • Advertising: ad slots are reserved on content pages only and are never shown on account pages.
    • +
  • Fonts: all fonts are served from our own servers, so viewing a page does not contact a font provider.
    • +
+ +

6. Browser-level protections

+

Our pages instruct your browser to limit what is shared on your behalf:

+
    +
  • When you follow a link or a page loads a resource from another website, that website learns only that you came from our domain, not which article you were reading.
    • +
  • Camera, microphone, location, motion sensors, payment and similar device features are disabled on every page and for any embedded content.
    • +
  • Our pages opt out of browser-based interest topics used for ad targeting.
    • +
+ +

7. Your choices

+

You can read the news on this website without an account. Your browser's settings let you clear cookies and site data or block third-party scripts at any time. For questions about your account data, or to have it corrected or deleted, please contact us using the details in our Imprint.
